parsed.refutation_attempt: The sink in question is a printf with a string literal format: printf("Received custom header: field1=%u, field2=%u\n", field1, field2). The format string contains no user-controlled data, and the arguments are numeric values parsed from the packet header (field1 and field2). Since no variable format string is used and no packet contents are directly passed to printf as part of the format string, there is no format string vulnerability or command injection path. The only untrusted data is the numeric header fields, which are safely converted to integers before printing.
